# Domain atlas

| Chart | Closed domain | Formula | Endpoint mechanism |
|---|---|---|---|
| identity | `[0,rho]` | zero image times `1+q` | opposite radial images paired before division |
| transition | `[rho,pi-delta]` | the same factorization with exact heat-time maxima | positive factor floor from `Qhat_0 < 1` |
| cut locus | `[pi-delta,pi]` | odd radial-image pairs in `phi=pi-theta` | principal-pair lower bound and removable `J_{b,t}` factor |

The charts cover `[0,pi]`.  The rational instance uses `rho=1`,
`delta=1/5`, and `0<t<=1/5`.  Radial image terms are distinguished from the
continuous `S^2` family of minimizing geodesics at the antipode.
